resources.string: Use silent test tracks to check title, playback state, progress and artwork in the vehicle media card. No commands are sent to a phone. End the CarPlay connection first.
Send navigation start, test road names and stop, then inspect the HUD or cluster. Unverified turn, distance and ETA fields are excluded. End the CarPlay connection first.
Recheck service and publish current road
You can leave this page to inspect the vehicle UI. Tests stop after two minutes, when ended, on a real connection, on consent withdrawal or on app exit.
A returned call does not confirm display. Record what you see, and check that test information clears after ending. Actions and errors enter the redacted log and can be uploaded manually from Logs.

Test while parked. Synthetic media or navigation information will be sent to vehicle services. Play may change the current media source. Tests are silent and last at most two minutes. Ending attempts to stop and unregister; also inspect the vehicle display.
Another reporting test is running or cleaning up
End the current CarPlay connection before starting a manual test.
No calls in this test yet. Unavailable or rejected services will show the affected stage.
